svg.text: Box decides (Atlas + file queue), machines work where they are suited, every job heartbeats — design 2026-10-17, Phases 0-2
RECOMMENDED HOME • 15 GB RAM — text/API work only, NO models/builds
• Atlas gate: publish / spend / send / ship ONLY
• Task card: type, target, tool/model, inputs,
• Only Atlas/Ian create approved cards; any bot
• Per-machine health files: load, free RAM/disk,
• Dead-man: every job pings on success —
USE CASE: frontier tool-use for multi-file coding
• gpt-6.1-sol — Box Hermes PRIMARY agentic coding
• MiniMax-M3 — Mini Hermes PRIMARY; Box fallback #2
• Claude Code / Codex — judgment vs mechanical
• Local 9B is NEVER the agentic-loop coder
MAC MINI — Apple + Local AI Worker
• LIMIT: 16 GB, ~11.3 GiB GPU, SPOF — shed on load
• Ollama qwen3:8b = bulk local coding assist
• Phase 1: ONE ACL port if Ian approves - - -
• becomes canonical ONLY by Ian declaration
• Neo: often offline — async only, never sync dep.
• Box has NO NAS path — by design
• ⛔ NO local models, NO heavy builds,
• ⛔ NO Apple builds on Box (15 GB, no GPU)
Mini down → dead-man alert → MBP cold-restore
Box down → MBP holds nightly queue/wiki copy;
re-issue from task cards (idempotent by id)
Mini load>8 or free RAM<1 GB → pause non-critical
Bulk sweeps → omarchy Ollama; fast path →
omarchy • Video → MBP • Cron where deps live
Phase 0 (this week): file queue + run log, read-only audits, no new infra.
Phase 1 (wk 2-3): heartbeats, oMLX probe + launchd, cron moves, omarchy ACL decision.
Phase 2 (wk 4-6): MBP restore drill, EXP-001/003/005/008 → ROUTING.md, LiteLLM/llama-swap only if triggered.
⚠ DESIGN ONLY — NO MACHINE CHANGES YET • Decisions Ian must make: control-plane home, omarchy role, vLLM timebox, cron moves, dead-man service
Dashed/conditional: omarchy serving port + LiteLLM pilot (Phase 2 trigger). Known unverified: tailnet ACL, omarchy specs, ~17 tok/s (unbenchmarked).

Sources: /workspace/orchestration-design-2026-10-17.md + architecture-review-2026-10-17.md + wiki infra/*.md • Verified 2026-10-17 • No IPs / keys / secrets shown • Icons: Simple Icons (see icons/) with text labels
